title: The Space Tent on Planet Wobble
done: You built the space tent! On Planet Wobble everything wobbles. Even the tent. Even you.

steps.say: The landing pad: lay a big square flat on the table, tile by tile.
The space tent: stand 3 squares in a triangle, each one joined to the last.
The space tent: stand corner triangles out from the corners, the straight side against the corner: legs.
The satellite dish: lean three triangles together until their tips meet. Hold them at the top.
The space tent, second layer: stack squares on the top edges.
The space tent: lean three triangles together until their tips meet. Hold them at the top.
